Please find attached our MSA redline and a draft Security Addendum (Redwood_MSA_Redline.pdf). Key proposed language for negotiation:

"Notwithstanding any other provision, with respect to liability arising from Data Security Incidents (as defined in the Security Addendum), Customer's recovery shall be limited to the greater of (a) aggregate fees paid to Redwood under the Order Form in the 12 months preceding the incident or (b) $500,000. - Require incident notification within 72 hours and a commitment to a third-party remediation audit within 180 days as a condition of the lower cap.
- Carve-outs for breaches of confidentiality, intentional data misuse, and persistent negligence to remain indemnifiable.
